context: A retired exec mentors a younger boss on leadership
purpose: Teach: 抽選/移籍/攻略/収納/主観/賛同/真摯/表彰

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 部下を真摯に評価しているか?
lines.en: Are you evaluating your subordinates with real sincerity?
lines.style: Measured, unhurried opening. Patient curiosity — not testing, genuinely asking. Slight weight on the word sincerity. Calm breath beneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。主観を排し、表彰候補は社内で賛同を取って決めています。
lines.en: Yes. I set personal bias aside, and we build consensus internally before naming award candidates.
lines.style: Direct and clear. A steady hand on the facts. Respectful but not deferential — speaking as a capable peer to someone whose judgment he trusts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 抽選的な「運」も、若手には大事だ。
lines.en: Even chance — that lottery luck — matters for the younger ones too.
lines.style: Gentle correction. Pause before 'chance' as if revealing something obvious once you see it. Warm but unsentimental. The voice of long experience settling into wisdom.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 承知しています。移籍した社員へのケアも怠っていません。
lines.en: I understand. We don't cut corners on support for people after they transfer.
lines.style: Firm acknowledgment. No defensiveness — just meeting the point head-on. Measured pace. The tone of someone taking instruction seriously, not just hearing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 攻略一辺倒の経営は危うい。ゆとりを収納する余裕も持て。
lines.en: Strategy alone will break you. You need room to breathe, space to let things settle.
lines.style: Slower now, more deliberate. The rhythm of warning wrapped in care. Each phrase stands alone slightly. Voice grounded — this is the hardest-won part of the lesson.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Quiet, sincere, definitive. A full breath before speaking. Simple words, held with weight. The sound of someone closing a door on old habits.
